lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
def runs(ch):
    from collections import defaultdict
    d=defaultdict(list)
    for r,row in enumerate(lines):
        for c in range(len(row)):
            if row[c]==ch and not (r==63 or c==63): d[r].append(c)
    out=[]
    for r in sorted(d):
        cs=sorted(d[r]); s=cs[0]; p=cs[0]
        for x in cs[1:]:
            if x==p+1: p=x
            else: out.append((r,s,p)); s=x; p=x
        out.append((r,s,p))
    return out
print("B:", runs('B'))
print("c:", runs('c'))
